name: Settings Dialog
description: Settings in one dialog: a column of sections with a sliding highlight, and rows of controls for the chosen one.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes, from the close button, Escape or the scrim.

props.name: section
props.description: The section shown (controlled). Use defaultSection when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSection
props.description: The section shown first when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSectionChange
props.description: Called when another section is chosen, by click or with the arrow keys.

props.name: defaultSettings
props.description: Starting values for the controls: workspaceName, language, timeZone, units, theme, mapStyle, compact, clock24, reduceMotion, avalancheBulletins, stormWarnings, mentions, morningSummary, weeklyReport, integrations.

props.name: onSettingChange
props.description: Called with the key and new value whenever a control changes.

props.name: plan
props.description: Overrides for the plan card and billing rows: name, price, interval, renews, usageLabel, usage, limit, resets, billingEmail, paymentMethod, invoices, and image, shown fading out of the card's top corner.

props.name: onUpgrade
props.description: Called by the Upgrade button on the plan card.

props.name: onExport
props.description: Called by the Export button under General.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel. It is 720 pixels wide and 560 tall, less on small screens.
